subject: Update before the holidays
body: Hi! BrightCo here with a quick update before the holidays. The new onboarding flow you designed went live on Monday and support tickets are already down. Our product team wants to start the mobile app sprint in December, so could you send a rough timeline and who would be on the team? We also need the source files for the illustrations, the Figma ones are fine. On this month's invoice, finance asked me to check whether 9% off would be possible since we are prepaying the next sprint. Separately, Priya will be your new point of contact from January. Thanks again, everyone here is really happy with the work!

subject: Lots of news
body: Hello from Skyline! We just closed our seed round, so expect more work from us next year. The landing page tests went well and conversion is up. Our CTO wants to review the API docs together next Thursday if that works for you. Also, since we are now a bigger account, we would like fifteen percent taken off the current invoice going forward. Let us know which slot works for the docs review, and congrats again on the great launch.
